scope: 3 matches per round for EACH of EPL, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and UCL; 1 per HK race day
volume_note: An active-month scenario, not a confirmed fixture calendar. 4-5 rounds per domestic league, 0-2 UCL rounds, 8-10 race days. Never manufacture extra picks when fewer eligible matches exist.
recommendation_budget: 60-80 completed videos in an active month
format: 4 question-answer pairs, about 20 seconds; two separately generated 10-second shots, locally edited together
allowance_note: 30% is a planning reserve for completed but unsatisfactory takes, not a measured failure rate. Failed HeyGen Creative Studio jobs are documented as refunded.

studio_plan.conditions: Studio-specific rates; must verify the cost beside Generate. Subscription does not pay API bills or prove a connector quota changes.

api.conditions: Actual reference selection and voice/motion quality must be tested. No assumption about an undocumented >15-second reference-to-video rate.
